title: About the changelog for v 0.112.0 - uvicorn is not installed by fastapi==0.110.3?
body:
### First Check

- [X] I searched the FastAPI documentation, with the integrated search.
- [X] I already searched in Google "How to X in FastAPI" and didn't find any information.
- [X] I already read and followed all the tutorial in the docs and didn't find an answer.
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Pydantic](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic).
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Swagger UI](https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui).
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [ReDoc](https://github.com/Redocly/redoc).

### Commit to Help

- [X] I commit to help with one of those options 👆

### Example Code

```python
pip install fastapi
```


### Description

Hi, thanks for fastapi, super useful!

We were looking at upgrading our internal fastapi version but [noticed this in the changelog](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/release-notes/#01120) for v 0.112.0:
> Before this, fastapi would include the standard dependencies, with Uvicorn and the fastapi-cli, etc..... now fastapi does not include those

However, when installing `fastapi-0.110.3` we do not get uvicorn. We only get `annotated-types anyio fastapi pydantic pydantic-core starlette typing-inspection`. Are the changelogs incorrect or am I interpreting them wrong? We just want to make sure we can safely upgrade to the new version without breaking lots of internal builds

answer.body:
Hello @fersarr 

The release notes are correct. Before 0.112.0 uvicorn would be installed with `pip install fastapi`:

```shell
pip install fastapi==0.111.1
Collecting...

pip freeze

....
starlette==0.37.2
typer==0.21.1
typing-inspection==0.4.2
typing_extensions==4.15.0
uvicorn==0.40.0
...
```

but you're right, for 0.110.3, pip freeze will show:

```shell
annotated-types==0.7.0
anyio==4.12.1
fastapi==0.110.3
idna==3.11
pydantic==2.12.5
pydantic_core==2.41.5
starlette==0.37.2
typing-inspection==0.4.2
typing_extensions==4.15.0
```

That's because it was introduced in [0.111.0](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/release-notes/#01110).
